Ofun: Eval & Debug

Dynamic code evaluation and debug printing.

Use Case 1: Dynamic Code Evaluation

// eval.ifa - Evaluate code strings at runtime

ese eval_expression(expr) {
    ayanmo result = Ofun.le(expr);
    Irosu.fo("Eval: " + expr + " => " + result);
    pada result;
}

ese safe_eval(expr) {
    ti (expr == ofifo || Ika.gigun(expr) == 0) {
        Irosu.kigbe("Empty expression");
        pada ofifo;
    }
    pada Ofun.le(expr);
}

// Usage
ayanmo result = eval_expression("2 + 2");
eval_expression("Obara.gbongbo(16)");
ayanmo val = safe_eval("Irosu.fo('Hello from eval')");

Use Case 2: Debug Printing

// debug.ifa - Inspect values at runtime

ese inspect(label, value) {
    Irosu.fo("=== " + label + " ===");
    Ofun.afiwe(value);
    Irosu.fo("================");
}

ese debug_flow(step, context) {
    Ofun.afiwe("Step: " + step);
    Ofun.afiwe(context);
}

// Usage
ayanmo data = "secret_data";
ayanmo count = 42;
ayanmo items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];

inspect("String value", data);
inspect("Number value", count);
inspect("List value", items);
debug_flow("init", "Starting application");
